Continue.description:
Starts or recovers a running run; a done run ignores it. Sent by a host, it cancels the armed continuation and
arms a fresh one with the flow's retry policy, without running flow code; the armed one replays the flow and
executes its next step.
Continue.title: Continue

FlowStatus.description: Whether a run is still running.

oneOf.description: Steps remain, or the flow has not yet returned.
The flow returned `Ok` after replaying every saved entry; the run keeps its state until it is deleted.

JournalEntry.description: One saved entry of a journal.

oneOf.description: The saved result of a step.

id.description: The step id: 1 through 100 characters of `A-Za-z0-9._~-:`, unique in the run.

result.description: The JSON result of its closure, `null` included.

oneOf.description: A durable sleep of [`Step::sleep`] until a store time: the flow goes on in the first turn at or after it.

id.description: The sleep id, from the same namespace as the step ids.

until.description: When the sleep ends; at most `MAX_INSTANT`.

SignUp.description: The input of the test flow.

state.description:
The state of a run: its input, the journal of saved results, its status and the id of its armed `Continue`.

On the wire: `{"input":{"user":"u1"},"journal":[{"kind":"step","id":"account","result":"a1"}],
"status":"running","armed":"m1"}`; `journal`, `status` and `armed` default to empty, running and null. A decoded
state is checked: at most 1000 entries with unique valid ids, sleeps until at most `MAX_INSTANT`, and no armed id
on a done run. A journal given at the create is trusted as progress: replay checks its order and result types
against the flow's code, not whether its effects happened.

armed.description: The id of the armed `Continue`; absent or null when none is armed, and always on a done run.

journal.description: The saved entries, in the order the flow reached them; at most 1000, with unique ids; absent: none.

state.title: FlowState
